name: Occulting
description: A steady beam interrupted by dark rings — light cut into counted dashes.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: conic-gradient(from 325deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 70deg, transparent 70deg 360deg), repeating-radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 0 9%, transparent 9% 18%); mask: conic-gradient(from 325deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 70deg, transparent 70deg 360deg), repeating-radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 0 9%, transparent 9% 18%); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
